statement: For every actual full pure pants involution, restriction of normalized continuous mod-two cochains to the three specified section subgroups is an explicit surjective differential graded algebra quasi-isomorphism onto F2[t0,t1,t2]/(ti tj for i different from j). Its kernel is acyclic. Every positive-degree higher Massey product with zero neighboring cups is defined and contains zero. The superdiagonal image of continuous representations into U_(n+1)(F2) is exactly the neighboring-cup-zero tuples, with specified section matrices, and has F_(n+2)^3 tuples. The actual cochain comparison with the standard involution is a displayed zigzag of these quasi-isomorphisms.
depends_on: D34 actual normalized involution, global sign, three section generators and zero fixed-subgroup first mod-two cohomology; A7 closed-subgroup cohomological dimension; A-KochloukovaZalesskii2007 Theorem 2 and its finite-dimensional restriction argument; explicit degree-one evaluation matrix, finite-quotient cochain sections, acyclic-kernel recursion and finite matrix multiplication proved here; R-PalQuick2025 Definition 6.1 identifies the target Boolean graded algebra
manuscript_passages: Section 31, folios 198-199 verso, scans 391-394; Part D(b), full pure three-cusp involution recognition and the exact remaining conjugator equation.
depends_on_doubtful_reading: None. The three actual section generators, their inclusion maps, the full normalized continuous cochain complex, its explicit target, and each finite-quotient cochain lift are specified.
notes: The proof gives actual morphisms of differential graded algebras and their cohomology isomorphisms. It uses no equality of full section centralizers and no real-projectivity assertion. The recursive defining-system lift stays inside the acyclic kernel of the displayed surjection. In degree one it is exactly a continuous upper unitriangular representation with prescribed higher entries zero on the three sections. The coefficient-two ring and these higher operations therefore have the same displayed comparison with the standard extension. The full profinite group conjugacy and the third-cusp condition of D35 remain unresolved.
computational_checks: work/root/research_data/pants_cochains_d72.py and its adjacent output verify the exact restriction matrix and inverse, all Boolean support products, the explicit normalized cochain restrictions and cup values, the Fibonacci image counts by an independent eight-state transfer calculation, and all specified section matrices for the enumerated finite character tuples. Full cohomology and continuous defining-system lifts are proved in the text.
